trees.name: Horizontal push
trees.notes: Push-up tree. Chest, front delts, triceps, with ring and one-arm branches.

nodes.name: Wall push-up
nodes.cues: Body rigid, hands at chest height, elbows about 45°

nodes.name: Incline push-up
nodes.advance: 3×8, then lower the surface or go to knee push-ups
nodes.cues: Hips in line, chest to the edge

nodes.name: Knee push-up
nodes.cues: Straight line from knees to head

nodes.name: Push-up
nodes.advance: RR: 3×8. Many coaches want 3×15–20 before one-arm work
nodes.cues: Elbows 30–45°, full lockout with a little protraction

nodes.name: Diamond / close push-up
nodes.cues: Hands under the sternum, elbows brush the ribs

nodes.name: Deficit push-up
nodes.cues: Chest drops below the hands; control the stretch

nodes.name: Archer push-up
nodes.cues: Assisting arm straight, weight shifted over the working hand

nodes.name: One-arm incline push-up
nodes.advance: 3×5–8 per side, lowering the incline over time
nodes.cues: Feet wide, hips square, no twisting

nodes.name: One-arm push-up
nodes.advance: 3×5 per side, then weighted or feet-elevated
nodes.cues: Wide stance, elbow tucked, squeeze glutes

nodes.name: Pseudo-planche push-up
nodes.advance: 3×8 with hands at the waist, then increase the lean. Leads into the planche push-up ladder
nodes.cues: Fingers out or back, protract, shoulders ahead of the hands

nodes.name: Ring push-up
nodes.cues: Rings close to the body, no shaking

nodes.name: RTO ring push-up
nodes.cues: Turn the rings out at lockout

nodes.name: Weighted push-up
nodes.advance: Work in 5–12 reps; add 2.5–5 kg when every set hits the top

trees.name: Vertical push
trees.notes: Overhead pressing for shoulders and triceps. Feeds the handstand push-up skill ladder.

nodes.name: Pike push-up
nodes.cues: Head travels in front of the hands (tripod), elbows about 45°

nodes.name: Feet-elevated pike push-up
nodes.advance: Sets of about 10 (THENX), then wall negatives

nodes.name: Wall HSPU negative
nodes.advance: Sets of about 5 slow 3–5 s lowers (THENX), then wall HSPU

nodes.name: Band overhead press
nodes.cues: Stand on the band, ribs down, press to lockout

trees.name: Dips
trees.notes: Downward push for chest, triceps and front delts. Parallel bar, straight bar and ring branches.

nodes.name: Support hold
nodes.cues: Shoulders down, elbows locked, slight hollow

nodes.name: Bench dip (optional regression)
nodes.advance: 3×12–15. Stop if the front of the shoulder hurts

nodes.name: Negative dip
nodes.advance: 3×5 slow 3–5 s lowers, then full dips
nodes.cues: Lower until the shoulder is below the elbow

nodes.name: Parallel bar dip
nodes.advance: RR: 3×8, then ring dips or weighted
nodes.cues: Slight forward lean, full depth, lock out

nodes.name: Weighted dip
nodes.advance: 5–8 reps; add load when all sets hit the top

nodes.name: Straight-bar dip
nodes.advance: 3×8–10. Calimove wants 5 deep reps before a clean bar muscle-up
nodes.cues: Lean over the bar, elbows back

nodes.name: Russian / Korean dip
nodes.cues: Needs shoulder extension mobility; ease in

nodes.name: Ring support hold, turned out
nodes.advance: 30 s turned out, then ring dips
nodes.cues: Rings by the hips, arms locked

nodes.name: Ring dip
nodes.advance: RR's final dip step. 3×8, then weighted or ring muscle-up
nodes.cues: Keep the rings close to the body

trees.name: Horizontal pull
trees.notes: Row tree for lats, mid and upper back, rear delts and biceps. Body angle is the main lever.

nodes.name: Vertical row (pole or doorframe)
nodes.cues: Lean back from something sturdy, squeeze the shoulder blades, 1 s pause

nodes.name: Incline row
nodes.advance: HC sternum-height base 3×30 (RR: 3×8), then go lower
nodes.cues: Body straight, pull chest to hands

nodes.name: Horizontal (Australian) row
nodes.advance: HC hip-height base 3×25; RR 3×8, then wide or archer
nodes.cues: Chest touches the bar, 1 s pause

nodes.name: Archer row
nodes.advance: RR: 3×8 per side, then one-arm row

nodes.name: Tuck front-lever row
nodes.cues: Hips at hand height, back flat

nodes.name: Weighted inverted row
nodes.advance: 5–12 reps; add load at the top of the range

trees.name: Vertical pull
trees.notes: Pull-up tree for lats, biceps, brachialis and grip. Two entry paths: RR and Hybrid Calisthenics.

nodes.name: Dead hang
nodes.cues: Passive hang, then active (shoulders pulled down)

nodes.name: Scapular pull
nodes.cues: Arms straight; pull shoulder blades down without bending elbows

nodes.name: Jackknife pull-up
nodes.cues: Feet on a box, legs help only as needed

nodes.name: Band-assisted pull-up
nodes.cues: Bands help most at the bottom; pair with negatives

nodes.name: Negative pull-up
nodes.advance: RR step 3: 3×5–8 slow 3–5 s lowers, then pull-up
nodes.cues: Jump to the top, lower to a full dead hang

nodes.name: Pull-up
nodes.cues: Dead hang to chin over bar, no kip, about shoulder-width grip

nodes.name: Chin-up (underhand)
nodes.cues: Underhand grip shifts more work to the biceps

nodes.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
nodes.cues: Pull the bar to the lower chest

nodes.name: Weighted pull-up
nodes.advance: RR step 5: 5–8 reps, add 1–2.5 kg when achieved

nodes.name: Archer pull-up
nodes.advance: HC: 2×9 per side, then the one-arm ladder

nodes.name: Typewriter pull-up
nodes.cues: Stay at the top while sliding across

trees.name: Squat
trees.notes: Knee-dominant work for quads and glutes, with shrimp, pistol, sissy and Cossack branches.

nodes.name: Assisted squat
nodes.cues: Hold a pole or frame, sit hips back and down

nodes.name: Bodyweight squat
nodes.advance: RR: 3×8 (many go to 3×20), then split squat
nodes.cues: Knees track the toes, full depth, heels down

nodes.name: Bulgarian split squat
nodes.advance: RR: 3×8 per leg, then shrimp or weighted
nodes.cues: Rear foot on a bench; lean forward for more glute

nodes.name: Beginner shrimp squat
nodes.cues: Rear knee to floor, hands may assist

nodes.name: Advanced shrimp squat
nodes.cues: Hold the rear foot; knee touches, toes don't

nodes.name: Weighted Bulgarian / step-up
nodes.advance: 6–12 reps, add load at the top

nodes.name: Assisted sissy squat
nodes.advance: 3×10–15. Progress slowly: high knee tendon load

nodes.name: Box pistol (into the pistol ladder)
nodes.cues: Sit to a lower box over time

trees.name: Hinge and posterior chain
trees.notes: Glutes and hamstrings at both the hip and the knee. The Nordic curl is the top rung.

nodes.name: Glute bridge
nodes.cues: Tuck the pelvis, drive through the heels

nodes.name: Single-leg RDL
nodes.advance: RR: 3×8 per leg, then banded Nordic

nodes.name: Nordic negative
nodes.advance: 3×3–6 slow lowers, catch with your hands

nodes.name: Full Nordic curl
nodes.advance: RR final step, 3×5. Programs with Nordics cut hamstring injuries by about 51%
nodes.cues: Straight line from knees to head

nodes.name: Reverse hyperextension
nodes.cues: Lift legs to body line, no swinging

trees.name: Core: anti-extension
trees.notes: Abs and deep core. The bodyline that every skill depends on.

nodes.name: Plank
nodes.advance: 3×10 s up to 1×60 s, then just maintain

nodes.name: Hollow hold (tuck → straddle → full)
nodes.cues: Low back pressed to the floor

nodes.name: Slider body saw
nodes.cues: Move from the shoulders, hips level

nodes.name: Ring ab rollout
nodes.advance: RR anti-extension step 2: 3×8–12; lower the rings to progress

trees.name: Core: compression
trees.notes: Abs and hip flexors. Leads into the L-sit, V-sit and dragon flag.

nodes.name: Seated pike compression lifts
nodes.cues: Hands beside the knees, lift the heels

nodes.name: Hanging knee raise
nodes.cues: No swing; tilt the pelvis up at the top

nodes.name: Toes-to-bar
nodes.cues: Press the bar down with straight arms

trees.name: Core: lateral and anti-rotation
trees.notes: Obliques, glute medius and adductors.

nodes.name: Side plank
nodes.advance: 10 s up to 60 s per side (RR bodyline)

nodes.name: Copenhagen plank (short, then long lever)
nodes.cues: Top leg on a bench, lift the bottom leg

trees.name: Calves
trees.notes: Squats don't load the calves through full range. Train them directly.

nodes.name: Calf raise, both legs
nodes.cues: Full stretch, 1–2 s pause at the top

nodes.name: Deficit calf raise on a step
Single-leg deficit calf raise
nodes.cues: Hold a wall lightly for balance

trees.name: Tibialis
trees.notes: Balances the calves and supports knees and ankles.

nodes.name: Wall tibialis raise
nodes.advance: 3×15–25, then walk the feet farther out
nodes.cues: Back on the wall, lift the toes high

nodes.name: Wall tib raise, farther or single-leg
Band dorsiflexion
nodes.cues: Band anchored in front of the foot

trees.name: Forearms, grip and wrists
trees.notes: Hanging grip plus the wrist prep that hand-balancing needs.

nodes.name: Towel hang / towel pull-up
nodes.cues: Towel over the bar, crush grip

nodes.name: False-grip hang
nodes.cues: Wrist over the ring, heel of hand on top

nodes.name: Wrist prep: palm pulses, back-of-hand push-ups
nodes.advance: Every hand-balancing session; progress from knees to full

trees.name: Rear delts and upper back
trees.notes: Posture and shoulder balance against heavy pushing.

nodes.name: Band pull-apart
nodes.cues: Straight arms, squeeze the shoulder blades

nodes.name: Band face pull
nodes.cues: Pull to the forehead, rotate out

nodes.name: Prone Y-T-W raises
nodes.cues: Thumbs up, lift from the shoulder blades

nodes.name: Ring face pull
nodes.cues: Elbows high, hands by the ears

trees.name: Biceps and brachialis
trees.notes: Optional isolation for intermediates. Pull-ups and rows cover beginners.

nodes.name: Bodyweight ring / bar curl
nodes.advance: 3×8–12; walk the feet forward to progress
nodes.cues: Elbows stay in front, body rigid

trees.name: Triceps
trees.notes: Long-head emphasis with arms overhead or in front.

nodes.name: Bodyweight triceps extension
nodes.cues: Hinge at the elbows, body rigid

trees.name: Neck
trees.notes: Load it gently and gradually.

nodes.name: Band neck work
nodes.cues: Smooth and controlled; skip aggressive bridges

trees.name: Glute medius and adductors
trees.notes: Hip stability for pistols, shrimps and healthy knees.

nodes.name: Cossack squat
nodes.cues: Heel down on the bent leg

trees.name: Rotator cuff
trees.notes: Shoulder health for rings, handstands and levers.

trees.name: Lower back
trees.notes: Spinal erectors and extension strength.

nodes.name: Arch (superman) hold
nodes.advance: RR bodyline: 10 s up to 60 s

nodes.name: Bench back extension
nodes.cues: A partner or strap holds the legs

trees.name: Scapular control and serratus
trees.notes: The base for every push, pull and straight-arm skill.

nodes.name: Support shrug (scapular dip)
nodes.cues: Rise and sink with locked arms

trees.name: Handstand
trees.notes: Entry: 30 s plank, then 60 s chest-to-wall handstand before balance drills. Needs shoulder flexion and wrist prep.

nodes.name: Wrist prep, 3–5 min
nodes.cues: Finger pulses, palm pulses, rotations, stretches

nodes.name: Chest-to-wall handstand
nodes.cues: Hollow, stacked, push tall; walk in

nodes.name: Wall heel pulls / toe taps
nodes.cues: Peel one heel, then both, off the wall

nodes.name: Freestanding handstand
nodes.cues: Balance with fingers and heel of the hand

nodes.name: One-arm handstand
nodes.advance: Very advanced; solid 60 s two-arm first

trees.name: Handstand push-up
trees.notes: Bent-arm overhead strength. A 3×5 wall HSPU is also Antranik's human flag prerequisite.

nodes.name: Wall HSPU
nodes.cues: Head to floor, press to lockout

nodes.name: 90° push-up
nodes.cues: Lower into a planche-like position and press back

trees.name: Planche
trees.notes: Straight-arm push skill. Very slow tendon adaptation, so expect months per rung.

nodes.name: Planche lean
nodes.cues: Protract, tuck the pelvis, elbows locked

nodes.name: Frog / crow stand
nodes.cues: Knees on the triceps, eyes forward

nodes.name: Tuck planche
nodes.cues: Arms locked, round the back, hips at shoulder height

nodes.name: Advanced tuck planche
nodes.cues: Flat back, knees away from the chest

nodes.name: Band-assisted planche (branch)
nodes.advance: Use to practise harder body lines

nodes.name: Planche push-up branch
nodes.advance: FitnessFAQs order: band-assisted → bodyweight → mechanical-advantage → pseudo-planche push-ups
nodes.cues: Keep the lean as you lower

trees.name: Front lever
trees.notes: Straight-arm pull skill. Simonster's intermediate entry: 12 dips, 8 pull-ups, 10 s tuck lever.

nodes.name: Tuck front lever
nodes.cues: Arms locked, shoulders down, pelvis tucked

nodes.name: Full front lever
nodes.cues: Straight line from ankles to shoulders

video.label: Front Lever Training Tutorial: tuck → full (YouTube, via Antranik)

trees.name: Back lever
trees.notes: Heavy on the biceps tendon and shoulder extension. Go slowly.

nodes.name: German hang
nodes.advance: Build to 30 s, feet assisted at first

nodes.name: Tuck back lever
nodes.cues: Arms locked, hips at hand height

video.label: RingFrat: The Back Lever Tutorial, tuck → half-lay (YouTube)

trees.name: Bar muscle-up
trees.notes: Calimove: 8–10 pull-ups, 8–10 dips and a 20–30 s false grip to start drills; about 12 pull-ups, 5 deep straight-bar dips and 3 explosive pull-ups for clean reps.

nodes.name: Explosive (high) pull-up
nodes.cues: Pull the bar toward the hips, not the chin

nodes.name: Kipping bar muscle-up
nodes.cues: Hollow, arch, then pull to the hips

trees.name: Ring muscle-up
trees.notes: The false grip is the key. Daniel Vadnal's floor: about 5 pull-ups, 5 dips and 10 push-ups before serious ring work.

nodes.name: False-grip hang
nodes.cues: Heel of the hand over the ring

nodes.name: False-grip rows / pull-ups
nodes.cues: Pull rings to the lower chest

nodes.name: Low-ring transition drill
nodes.cues: Rings to the ribs, then lean over

nodes.name: Ring muscle-up
nodes.cues: Keep the rings close through the transition

trees.name: Human flag
trees.notes: Needs a vertical pole or stall bars. Antranik's prerequisite: 3×5 wall HSPU.

nodes.name: Vertical flag
nodes.cues: Bottom arm pushes, top arm pulls

nodes.name: Band-assisted flag (branch)
nodes.advance: Use for straddle and full lines

trees.name: L-sit → V-sit → manna
trees.notes: Compression plus straight-arm support. Flexibility is half the work.

nodes.name: Tuck L-sit
nodes.cues: Knees to chest, hips off the floor

nodes.name: Manna
nodes.cues: Shoulder extension strength plus extreme compression

trees.name: One-arm pull-up
trees.notes: Unilateral pulling ladder. Heavy weighted pull-ups build the base.

nodes.name: Assisted one-arm pull-up
nodes.cues: Assisting hand on the forearm or a towel; use less over time

nodes.name: One-arm pull-up
nodes.cues: Chin over the bar, minimal swing

trees.name: Pistol squat
trees.notes: Strength plus balance, ankle and hip mobility.

nodes.name: Assisted pistol (holding support)
nodes.cues: Use your hands only as needed

nodes.name: Elevated pistol (on a box)
nodes.cues: Free leg hangs below box level

nodes.name: Pistol squat
nodes.cues: Heel down, knee tracks the toes

trees.name: Dragon flag
trees.notes: Grip a bench or pole behind your head.

nodes.name: Tuck dragon flag negatives
nodes.cues: Weight on the upper back, not the neck

trees.name: Elbow lever
trees.notes: An accessible balance skill, but hard on the wrists.

nodes.name: Two-arm elbow lever
nodes.cues: Elbows into the hips, body horizontal
